title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 code execution was possible in untrusted projects via the Terraform…
description: A code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4. The flaw allows code execution in untrusted projects via the Terraform tool path setting. This vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
